Name: Aster and Nari's Japanese Wallpaper and Flooring
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: Several wallpaper and flooring for Alternative Textures or Content Patcher
Description:
_Description_

*   Several wallpaper and flooring for Alternative Textures

*   Walls and floors are tagged with numbers and keywords (Asterisk, Narianka, Japanese) so it's easier to navigate using Alternative Texture's search feature

_Quick start instructions_
1. Figure out which version of the mod you need. You only need __one__ file.

*   Alternative Textures version - Lets you search textures using keywords. In-game you need to  buy the paint bucket tool from robins and use it on your walls

*   Mobile version - There are two content patcher versions. One is 1.4 Mobile compatible and replaces vanilla textures.

*   The other CP version _adds_ items to the wallpaper catalogue instead of replacing them, but isn't mobile compatible until mobile gets the 1.5 update.
2. Download and unzip this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder. (If you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)  )

_Mods made specifically to go with this one_

*   [Ink painting wide wallpaper](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12989)

*   [Chests and minifridges as baskets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12219)

*   [PortaPool](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12137) has several matching patterns added to wood flooring and paths

_Other mods that work well with this one_

*   [AT tools retexture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9984)

*   [Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896)

*   [Aster's Big Furniture Pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240)

*   [SinceWayLastMay's Orchid Pack](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5278)

*   [Idaida's Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10932)

*   [Seasonal Japanese buildings and craftables](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9704)

*   [Aura's Japanese Furniture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10212)

_Art credits_

*   Narianka has kindly allowed me to use textures from her [Pastel Rainbow Wallpapers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11896)
